diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

resource.helm_release.karpenter has an explicit depends_on on :module.eks, but it already depends on module.eks implicitly through attribute references in its values template (module.eks.cluster_name and module.eks.cluster_endpoint in the settings block). The explicit depends_on duplicates an existing implicit dependency and can be removed.
